item.title: Clinical Programmes Officer at Congenital Heart Disease Foundation of Nigeria (CHDFNigeria)
item.description: Congenital Heart Disease Foundation of Nigeria (CHDFNigeria) is recruiting to fill the position of: Clinical Programmes Officer. The position is located in Lagos State. Candidate must be a medical doctor or highly experienced registered nurse with extensive cardiac experience.

item.title: Field Credit Officer (Edo) at Moniepoint Incorporated - 3 Openings
item.description: Moniepoint Incorporated is recruiting to fill the position of: Field Credit Officer. The position is located in Edo North, Central and Ovia - Edo State. Interested candidates should possess minimum of an OND in any Business-related discipline with a minimum of 2 years experience in a sales role for credit products in a financial institution.

item.title: Service Center Operations Manager at Moniepoint Incorporated
item.description: Moniepoint Incorporated is recruiting to fill the position of: Service Center Operations Manager. The position is located in Lagos State. Interested candidates should possess a Bachelors Degree in Finance, Business Administration, or Operations Management with a minimum of 5+ years in Banking Operations, with at least 3 years managing multiple branches/sites (Area Manager or Cluster Manager level).

item.title: Digital Content Manager at Orange Group
item.description: Orange Group is recruiting to fill the position of: Digital Content Manager. The position is located in Lagos State. Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor's Degree with 35 years' post-NYSC experience in a related field.

item.title: Rome Business School Nigeria Job Recruitment (3 Positions)
item.description: Rome Business School Nigeria is recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the following positions in Lagos State: Business Development Manager - Corporate Training; Admission and Sales Advisor; and Marketing Executive.
